usedFor: Shopify is where new products go live; PostSpread schedules the social posts. A “New Product” in Shopify can run “Create Post” so the launch goes out across your accounts.

bestTemplate.name: “New Product” in Shopify, then “Create Post” in PostSpread
bestTemplate.why: “Create Post” can publish now, schedule or save a draft, so a new product goes out with the timing and review you want.

watchOut: Choose between publish now, schedule or draft in “Create Post”. Publish now posts straight to your social accounts. “Abandoned Checkout” is polling.
